speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are suffering from severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, and dysuria. To begin our assessment, on a scale of 1 to 10, how would you rate the severity of your abdominal pain, and where exactly do you feel it most intensely?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old female. The patient presents with a 5-day history of severe abdominal pain and cramping, accompanied by nausea and vomiting. She reports pain with urination and also experienced burning pain during sexual intercourse 3 days ago. She mentions being sexually active with one male partner, using condoms inconsistently.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Pelvic Inflammatory Disease (PID)

I have noted your age, sexual history, and symptoms of dysuria and post-coital pain. Given the 5-day history of severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, and the specific mention of burning during intercourse, I suspect an ascending genital infection. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis; REQUEST TEST: Cervical Swab for Chlamydia/Gonorrhea; REQUEST TEST: CBC, CRP, ESR.
